title: Herb Buttermilk Biscuits
description: These herb biscuits are seasoned with savory herbs and kelp and moistened with buttermilk and butter for a fluffy texture that melts in your mouth.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Whisk together flour, baking powder, parsley, basil, sugar, thyme, savory, kelp powder, and salt in a large bowl.

Cut in butter with a knife or pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Drizzle buttermilk slowly over flour mixture while tossing lightly with a fork, just until flour mixture is moistened.

Turn dough out onto a floured board; knead 4 to 5 times. Pat dough into a 3/4-inch-thick circle. Cut out 12 biscuits with a 2-inch cookie cutter, re-shaping dough as needed. Place biscuits 2 inches apart on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 8 minutes. Serve warm.

video.description: Add these herb biscuits to your next brunch menu! They are perfect, melt in your mouth, fluffy, and savory. They will add to the meal whether you’re having eggs, tofu scramble, or cover them with gravy! Perfect to pair with butter, and if you have jam – slather that on as well. It’ll give you the sweet and savory blend that will leave you smiling and full.
